method.protocolAdaptation: The citation-audit skill supplied claim-context and independence discipline, narrowed to semantic deltas as requested. Only a suspected factual contradiction triggered primary-source reopening.
method.editedReview: Reviewed all 214 current changed paragraph/comment lines and 215 replaced/deleted baseline lines across 39 edited reports against git baseline 777f49a036bee51c2bc704db65c684d830311408.
method.retainedReview: Verified the 16 retained reports by exact SHA-256 identity across git baseline, current bytes, and the author ledger. No fresh source audit is claimed for them.
method.protectedContent: Independently compared ordered numeric tokens, formulas, pipe-table lines, headings, raw URLs, Markdown destinations, figure targets, complete image lines, non-comment frontmatter, and final newline form.
method.productionPolicy: Production report files remained read-only. No email, push, publication, or external action was performed.

issues.finding: The edited comment/opening correctly say four cities and six intersections, but the unchanged method paragraph says the four named cities cover three intersections. The report is internally inconsistent and the latter count is wrong.
issues.currentText: 固定 arXiv v1 §III–V 覆盖长春、天津、西安和重庆三个路口，总录制 22.8 小时、约 53k 条参与者轨迹，累计轨迹距离 4,188.25 km。

checkedSections: III-A Data Collection and Scenario Distribution
exactFacts: The paper states that SinD 2.0 includes six signalized intersections across four cities.
Changchun, Tianjin, and Xi’an contribute one named site each; Chongqing contributes three intersections.
Table II enumerates cc, tj, cqIR, cqNR, cqR, and xa, totaling six sites.

issues.requiredCorrection: State one intersection each in Changchun, Tianjin, and Xi’an plus three in Chongqing, totaling six intersections across four cities.
issues.suggestedText: 固定 arXiv v1 §III–V 覆盖长春、天津、西安各一个路口，以及重庆三个路口，共四城六个信号路口；总录制 22.8 小时、约 53k 条参与者轨迹，累计轨迹距离 4,188.25 km。
